thread:
thomas: FYI running long-context runs on H100 I'm seeing steady GPU mem growth even after evictions kick in. Paging stats show reuse hit rate dropping over time. Anyone seen similar?

marta: @thomas logs?

thomas: ```
KV_PAGER: evict page idx=1024 owner=task-77 freed=2048 reuse_hit=0
KV_PAGER: evict page idx=1025 owner=task-78 freed=2048 reuse_hit=0
PAGE_TABLE: pte[0x3f8]->state=0x3 owner=0x7fff...
...
profiler: paged_attn_kern_v2    1.2ms   3.4ms  (H100)
profiler: paged_attn_kern_v2    2.8ms   5.1ms  (A100)
profiler: kv_copy_kernel        0.25ms  0.9ms
```

ryan: could be ordering of evict vs copy on H100 needing different stream/ordering semantics. A100 stream ops were fine last week. Did you see any cudaMemcpyAsync -> cudaStreamSynchronize missing?

thomas: not explicitly. here's repro command: `./run_infer --model xxx --ctx 512k --batch 8 --pager=on --seed 42`

alex: hmm also check kernel selection path: we recently added `tiled_kv_copy` for sm90 but fallback on sm80 uses different atomic ops. If page-table updates rely on compare-exchange semantics might be racy.

marta: can reproduce on internal A100 cluster? try a small run please.

ryan: I can run quick on a100-1 in perf queue, will ping when done.

infra-bot: job started: perf/job/4267 on a100-1 (ETA ~10m)

ryan: quick result: no mem growth, reuse hit ~98% after 1M tokens. baseline looks good on A100.

thomas: H100 run still shows mem +200MB per 100k tokens; reuse dips to 65% then fragmentation increases.

alex: can you dump page-table map? maybe fragmentation of page fragments.

thomas: ```
PAGE_TABLE SNAPSHOT:
pte[0x1f4]=page=1024 frag=3 size=4096 owner=task-77 state=LIVE
pte[0x1f5]=page=0    frag=0 size=0    owner=0        state=FREE
free_list.len=0
alloc_counters: small_pages=312 large_pages=0
```

marta: sounds like free-list starvation. maybe eviction didn't push to free_list due to lock-free freelist ABA issue on sm90 kernels after the tiled copy rewrite.

ryan: try force single-threaded eviction path (ENV `KV_PAGER_FORCE_SYNC=1`) — does it fix?

thomas: testing... result: mem stable, reuse 99%. So likely concurrency bug in fast path.

alex: ok tentative root cause: freelist ABA on new smaller page granularity + sm90 kernel reorder changes atomics. Plan: add version-tagging to free list nodes and fallback atomic CAS loop, add unit test that stresses evict+alloc with high concurrency.

marta: create PR with test, assign to thomas+alex. Also add perf test on both A100/H100 nightly pools to catch regressions.

thomas: opened PR #3124, added reproducer and forced-sync test. cc @ryan for perf runs.

ryan: one more note: check kernel occupancy on H100; the new tiled kernel uses fewer warps which might widen race windows.

marta: thanks all. next steps: thomas+alex hotfix to release branch if CI green. We'll monitor for 48h.

thomas: :thumbsup:
